title: OutBun-napoli97
name: OutBun-napoli97
summary: 1997: race a souped-up white Fiat 500 around the Sorrento and Amalfi coasts for the best rosetta panino in Campania.
description: An OutRun-inspired pseudo-3D arcade racer on the real 1997 coast road from Napoli to Vietri sul Mare: SS18, the SS145 Sorrentina with its tunnels and the Seiano viaduct, the Massa Lubrense road to Nerano and the SS163 Amalfitana with its hairpins and the Furore bridge. Nine timed legs, each with a local ingredient (rosetta, piennolo tomatoes, provolone del Monaco, olive oil, Sorrento lemons, zucchine alla Nerano, fior di latte, Cetara anchovies and tuna) to stack into the ultimate panino. Race three CPU classics (Fiat 126, Citroen Dyane, VW Beetle) or up to three friends over PRG32 multiplayer.
controls: D-pad, A accelerate, B brake, UP/DOWN gears, START pause
fiction_notice: A fictional race on real roads. Fiat, Citroen, Volkswagen, Piaggio and SITA are named descriptively as period vehicles; no logos or trademarks are reproduced and no affiliation is implied. The real SS145 and SS163 are narrow and busy: drive them gently.
